name: Tomato plate
intro: Thick slices of the best tomatoes of the year, something cool beside them, and a protein on top. The meal July does best.

proteins.name: Wild salmon, leftover
proteins.timing: Broken into flakes, cold or barely warmed. Nothing to cook.

proteins.name: Shrimp
proteins.timing: Seared in a smoking-hot pan, 1–2 minutes a side.

proteins.name: Burrata
proteins.timing: No meat. Torn over the tomatoes. Nothing to cook.

needs: A small handful of basil and mint

steps.text: Slice the tomatoes thick, lay them on the plate, and salt them. Their juice becomes the dressing.
Shrimp: heat a pan until it smokes, add a little oil and the shrimp, and cook until pink. Salmon or burrata: nothing to cook.
Slice the cucumber and tuck it around the tomatoes. Add your protein.
Your flavor over the top, then the herbs, torn.
Olive oil, flaky salt, and black pepper last.

leftovers: It doesn't keep — tomatoes go mealy in the fridge. Make it fresh.
